My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Your item arrived damaged. According to our warranty information, the best next step is to report the damage promptly so the item can be evaluated. After inspection, if the product is determined to be defective, it may be repaired or replaced at no charge. In some cases, replacement parts may be sent if the issue is simple to fix.
Key details from our policy:
- Please notify us as soon as possible after discovering the damage.
- You may receive instructions for inspection or return of the damaged item.
- In some cases, you may need to ship the item to NANUK for inspection.
- If the product is confirmed defective, return shipping reimbursement may be available with valid proof of payment.
In your next message, I can assist you with the fastest path depending on your situation:
- damaged NANUK case/bag/accessory
- damage to the outer shipping box only
- help checking your order details if you are signed in
If you prefer, I can also connect you with a human representative. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
